evidence.text:
Spanish language
In Europe , Spanish is an official language of Spain , the country after which it is named and from which it originated . It is widely spoken in Gibraltar , and also commonly spoken in Andorra , although Catalan is the official language there .

Celtic Britons
The Britons , also known as Celtic Britons or Ancient Britons , were Celtic people who inhabited Great Britain from the British Iron Age into the Middle Ages , at which point their culture and language diverged into the modern Welsh , Cornish and Bretons ( among others ) . They spoke the Common Brittonic language , the ancestor to the modern Brittonic languages .

Welsh language
Welsh evolved from Common Brittonic , the Celtic language spoken by the ancient Celtic Britons . Classified as Insular Celtic , the British language probably arrived in Britain during the Bronze Age or Iron Age and was probably spoken throughout the island south of the Firth of Forth . During the Early Middle Ages the British language began to fragment due to increased dialect differentiation , evolving into Welsh and the other Brittonic languages . It is not clear when Welsh became distinct .
